Some key notes before you open a PR:

 1. All PRs are merged into the `develop` branch
 2. Commit messages follow the [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) convention (enforced by commitlint in CI)
 3. All tests pass locally: `bench --site <site> run-tests --app stripe_payment`
 4. All business logic and validations must be on the server-side (amounts, references, and settlement guards are never trusted from the client)
 5. Update necessary Documentation
 6. Put `closes #XXXX` in your comment to auto-close the issue that your PR fixes

Also, if you're new here

- Contribution Guide => https://github.com/aerele/stripe-payment/blob/develop/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md
